description: This Java source file defines the class DataValidatorBuilder, which provides a fluent API for building and performing data validation checks on various parameters within a software application, likely related to API data validation in the Apache Fineract project.

classes.name: DataValidatorBuilder
classes.description: A utility class that supports the construction of complex validation logic for API parameters, providing methods to validate data types, formats, ranges, patterns, date constraints, and more, while collecting validation errors to be thrown as exceptions.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Creates a new DataValidatorBuilder instance with the same validation errors, resetting the internal state.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges validation errors from another DataValidatorBuilder instance into this one.

methods.name: hasError
methods.description: Checks if there are any validation errors collected.

methods.name: getDataValidationErrors
methods.description: Returns the list of collected validation errors.

methods.name: resource
methods.description: Sets the resource context for validation errors.

methods.name: parameter
methods.description: Assigns the parameter being validated.

methods.name: parameterAtIndexArray
methods.description: Sets parameter context for indexed array validation.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Sets the value of the parameter to validate.

methods.name: ignoreIfNull
methods.description: Configures the builder to ignore null values during validation.

methods.name: andNotBlank
methods.description: Adds a validation error if a linked parameter is populated but the linked value is blank.

methods.name: failWithCode
methods.description: Adds a validation error with a specific error code.

methods.name: failWithCodeNoParameterAddedToErrorCode
methods.description: Adds a validation error without appending the parameter to the error code.

methods.name: equalToParameter
methods.description: Validates that the current value equals the specified linked value.

methods.name: notSameAsParameter
methods.description: Validates that the current value is not the same as the linked parameter value.

methods.name: trueOrFalseRequired
methods.description: Validates that a boolean parameter is either 'true' or 'false' (case-insensitive).

methods.name: notNull
methods.description: Adds an error if the value is null, unless ignoreNullValue is true.

methods.name: notBlank
methods.description: Adds an error if the value is blank (null, empty, or whitespace).

methods.name: notExceedingLengthOf
methods.description: Checks that the string length does not exceed max length.

methods.name: notExceedingListLengthOf
methods.description: Checks that a list's size does not exceed max length.

methods.name: inMinMaxRange
methods.description: Validates that an integer value falls within a specified range.

methods.name: isOneOfTheseValues
methods.description: Checks that the value is one of the specified acceptable values.

methods.name: isOneOfEnumValues
methods.description: Checks that the value is one of the enum constants of a given enum class.

methods.name: isOneOfTheseStringValues
methods.description: Checks that the string value matches one of the provided string options.

methods.name: isNotOneOfTheseValues
methods.description: Validates that the value is not one of the specified values.

methods.name: positiveAmount
methods.description: Ensures that a numeric value is greater than zero.

methods.name: zeroOrPositiveAmount
methods.description: Ensures that a numeric value is zero or greater.

methods.name: integerZeroOrGreater
methods.description: Validates that an integer is zero or positive.

methods.name: integerGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Validates that an integer is greater than zero.

methods.name: integerGreaterThanNumber
methods.description: Checks that an integer is greater than a specified number.

methods.name: integerEqualToOrGreaterThanNumber
methods.description: Checks that an integer is greater than or equal to a specified number.

methods.name: integerSameAsNumber
methods.description: Validates that an integer value matches a specified number.

methods.name: integerInMultiplesOfNumber
methods.description: Checks whether an integer is a multiple of a specified number.

methods.name: longGreaterThanZero
methods.description: Validates that a long value is greater than zero.

methods.name: longZeroOrGreater
methods.description: Validates that a long is zero or greater.

methods.name: longGreaterThanNumber
methods.description: Checks whether a long value is greater than a specified number.

methods.name: arrayNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks that an array is not empty.

methods.name: listNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks that a list is not empty.

methods.name: jsonArrayNotEmpty
methods.description: Checks that a JSON array has at least one element.

methods.name: expectedArrayButIsNot
methods.description: Records an error if a parameter expected to be an array is not.

methods.name: anyOfNotNull
methods.description: Validates that at least one of the provided objects is non-null.

methods.name: inValidValue
methods.description: Records an error for an invalid parameter value.

methods.name: mustBeBlankWhenParameterProvided
methods.description: Ensures that the parameter is blank when another parameter is provided.

methods.name: mustBeBlankWhenParameterProvidedIs
methods.description: Ensures that the parameter is blank when a specific parameter value is provided.

methods.name: cantBeBlankWhenParameterProvidedIs
methods.description: Ensures that the parameter is present when another parameter has a specific value.

methods.name: compareMinimumAndMaximumAmounts
methods.description: Checks that the minimum amount is less than the maximum amount.

methods.name: inMinAndMaxAmountRange
methods.description: Validates that a specified amount is within min and max boundaries.

methods.name: notLessThanMin
methods.description: Checks that a numeric value is not less than a minimum.

methods.name: notGreaterThanMax
methods.description: Checks that a numeric value does not exceed a maximum.

methods.name: matchesRegularExpression
methods.description: Validates that the string matches a regex pattern.

methods.name: validateStringFor
methods.description: Internal method to validate that a string value is within a set of valid options.

methods.name: validateForBooleanValue
methods.description: Validates that a string value matches 'TRUE' or 'FALSE'.

methods.name: validatePhoneNumber
methods.description: Validates the format of a phone number string.

methods.name: validateCronExpression
methods.description: Validates that a string is a valid cron expression.

methods.name: validateDateAfter

methods.name: validateDateBefore

methods.name: validateDateAfterOrEqual

methods.name: validateDateBeforeOrEqual

methods.name: validateDateForEqual
methods.description: Validates that a date parameter equals a specific date.

methods.name: scaleNotGreaterThan
methods.description: Checks that a decimal's scale (number of decimal places) does not exceed a specified limit.
